overview: Close all tracker gaps between the web workbench tracker and the Expo mobile app: project CRUD, metadata management, richer issue field parity, sub-issue parity, issue delete, labels/tags, comment edit/delete/reactions/mentions, rich comment composition, activity timeline, saved filters, kanban enhancements, bulk operations, templates, and my-issues surfaces.

scopeCuts: Focus on tracker parity inside mobile tracker routes, hooks, repositories, and adjacent components
Exclude tracker workspace administration, permission matrices, and non-tracker integrations

prerequisites: Existing scaffold/auth/api client/tracker phases are already implemented in mobile/
mobile-richtext should be complete before rich issue-description or comment composition parity is called done
mobile-attachments should be complete before issue attachment parity is called done
nonGoals: Rebuilding the full workbench viewlet/filter architecture on mobile
Porting tracker workspace settings screens from Svelte one-to-one
Changing server-side tracker models or web tracker behavior
Introducing non-tracker admin surfaces into the tracker tab
contracts: Persistence and mutations continue to flow through mobile/src/repositories/tracker.ts
Server state remains in TanStack Query; draft/preferences remain in Zustand
New tracker routes must stay under mobile/src/app/(app)/tracker/**
New create/edit surfaces must not regress the existing create route
If project metadata required for a form is not loaded, the form must block submission with an explicit state instead of silently sending partial payloads

tasks.title: Expand tracker repository parity contract
tasks.description: Add repository methods for project detail, project members, components, milestones, issue relations, template summaries, time-report mutations, and the richer issue-filter query contract used by parity screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository exposes typed read methods for project detail, components, milestones, members, issue relations, template summaries, labels, and my-issues queries.
Repository exposes typed write methods for project create/update, component create/update, milestone create/update, issue time reporting, issue delete, and label assignment.
Filter/query contract supports component, milestone, assignee, due date, label, and relation-aware filters without leaking raw transport errors for missing project-scoped entities.

tasks.title: Extend tracker hooks for parity data and mutations
tasks.description: Wire the repository parity contract into TanStack Query so project metadata, relations, templates, my-issues, and advanced filters all stay centralized.
acceptanceCriteria: Hooks expose project detail, component, milestone, template, relation, and my-issues queries without forcing screens to call repositories directly.
Project, component, milestone, and issue-field mutations invalidate the exact project and issue keys they affect.
Disabled queries stay inert when projectId or issueId is absent, and advanced filter params participate in stable query keys.

tasks.title: Expand tracker store for full draft and filter parity
tasks.description: Extend the tracker Zustand store so create/edit flows and advanced filters can carry the full parity field set without ad hoc screen state.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft state includes component, milestone, due date, estimation, parent issue, template selection, and attachment ids.
Filter state includes component, milestone, assignee, due-date, and relation-aware options, and clearing the draft resets all parity fields.
Persisted state does not leak stale project-specific selections across workspace changes.

tasks.title: Add project create flow
tasks.description: Introduce a mobile project-create route and form so tracker parity includes project creation and the defaults that issue creation depends on.
acceptanceCriteria: Tracker index exposes a create-project entry point and the new route resolves with typed navigation.
Project form supports name, identifier, privacy, default assignee, and default issue status.
Submitting invalid or duplicate identifiers shows a recoverable validation state instead of closing the form.

tasks.title: Add project edit flow
tasks.description: Add project-scoped edit routing so an existing project can be modified through a stable project/[id]/edit route.
acceptanceCriteria: Project detail exposes an edit entry point that routes to project/[id]/edit.
Edit form loads the existing project defaults and saves only valid changes for the targeted project.
If the project has been deleted or archived, the edit route shows a recoverable error state instead of a blank screen.

tasks.title: Add component and milestone management surfaces
tasks.description: Bring project-scoped tracker metadata management to mobile with project-addressable routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can navigate from a specific project into component and milestone management routes scoped to that project id.
Lists render human-readable labels, lead/status metadata, and empty states for projects with no entries.
Archived or deleted entities are excluded from selection lists after mutation invalidation.

tasks.title: Add issue field editor components
tasks.description: Create the missing editor and picker surfaces required for issue-detail and issue-form parity so the integration tasks do not overload existing files.
acceptanceCriteria: Component, milestone, and relation pickers render project-scoped choices from the parity hooks.
Pickers support empty and not-found states without rendering raw ids.
Selecting a value returns stable ids usable by issue detail and issue form without additional screen-level lookups.

tasks.title: Bring issue detail to field parity
tasks.description: Upgrade issue detail from a mostly-read surface into the parity screen for component, milestone, parent/sub-issue, relation, due date, estimation, time spent, and attachments.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue detail renders editable component, milestone, due date, estimation, parent issue, relations, and sub-issue summaries using real lookup data.
Time-report creation and refresh update reported-time UI without forcing a full app reload.
Missing related docs or deleted parents show a safe fallback row instead of rendering raw refs or crashing the screen.

tasks.title: Bring create/edit issue flow to parity
tasks.description: Upgrade issue creation into a shared create/edit form that supports the parity field set and proper project defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared form supports status, priority, assignee, component, milestone, due date, estimation, parent issue, description markup, and attachments.
Edit mode preloads existing issue state and preserves parity fields when saving partial changes.
Submission is blocked when required project defaults or parity metadata are still loading, instead of sending partial payloads.

tasks.title: Add issue templates flow
tasks.description: Expose tracker issue templates on mobile so users can start from the same reusable tracker patterns available on the web.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile tracker exposes a template list with project-scoped template summaries and empty/error states.
Selecting a template hydrates the create form draft without discarding manually-entered overrides.
Templates that reference missing metadata surface a blocking explanation instead of creating malformed issues.

tasks.title: Add my-issues and advanced filter UI parity
tasks.description: Close the remaining day-to-day parity gap by adding a personal issue entry point and the richer filter UI that consumes the expanded repository/store/hook contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile exposes a dedicated My Issues surface scoped to the authenticated user with the same repository/filter contract as project issues.
Filter UI supports component, milestone, assignee, due date, and relation-aware combinations without raw-id rendering.
Clearing or restoring saved filters resets both list and search results consistently.

tasks.title: Add issue delete flow
tasks.description: Add a delete action to issue detail with confirmation dialog and proper cache invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue detail header exposes a delete action (via menu or icon) that opens a confirmation dialog with the issue identifier.
Successful deletion invalidates the project issue list, navigates back, and removes the issue from query cache.
Attempting to delete an already-deleted issue shows a recoverable error instead of a crash.

tasks.title: Add labels/tags support on issues
tasks.description: Bring label/tag assignment to issue detail and issue create/edit forms matching the web tracker label system.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue detail renders assigned labels as colored chips and allows adding/removing via a label picker.
Issue create/edit form includes a label selector that shows project-scoped labels with color indicators.
Labels with deleted or missing refs render a safe fallback instead of raw ids.

tasks.title: Add comment edit/delete and activity timeline
tasks.description: Upgrade the comments section to support edit/delete on user comments and display system activity messages (status changes, field updates) in a unified timeline.
acceptanceCriteria: User comments show edit and delete actions (via long-press or swipe) for comments authored by the current user.
Activity timeline renders system messages (DocUpdateMessage, ActivityInfoMessage) with human-readable field-change descriptions alongside user comments.
Editing a comment preserves the original timestamp and shows an edited indicator; deleting shows a confirmation first.

tasks.title: Add comment reactions and mentions
tasks.description: Add emoji reactions on comments and @mention rendering/insertion in the comment composer.
acceptanceCriteria: Comments display reaction pills (emoji + count) and long-press opens a reaction picker to add/remove reactions.
Comment composer supports @mention insertion via a searchable member picker triggered by typing @.
Rendered mentions in existing comments are tappable and navigate to the referenced user/document.

tasks.title: Add saved/custom filters
tasks.description: Allow users to save, name, and recall filter presets for issue lists.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can save the current filter combination as a named preset persisted to AsyncStorage.
Saved filters appear in a picker accessible from the filter bar with options to apply, rename, or delete.
Saved filters are scoped per-workspace and cleared on workspace switch to prevent stale cross-workspace state.

tasks.title: Kanban multi-grouping and drag-drop
tasks.description: Extend kanban view to support grouping by assignee, priority, component, and milestone, and add drag-drop card movement between columns.
acceptanceCriteria: Kanban view offers a grouping picker (status, assignee, priority, component, milestone) persisted in tracker store.
Drag-drop between columns updates the grouped field with optimistic UI.
Columns with no issues show an empty placeholder; grouping by fields with many values limits visible columns with a show more action.

tasks.title: Bulk issue operations
tasks.description: Add multi-select mode to the issue list with bulk status, priority, and assignee changes. Extends the existing BulkActionBar.tsx (used by inbox) with tracker-specific actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-press on an issue row enters selection mode with checkboxes; a bottom action bar shows selected count and available actions.
Bulk actions support changing status, priority, and assignee for all selected issues in a single batch (Promise.all in chunks of 50).
Exiting selection mode clears all selections and restores normal list interaction without stale visual state.

tasks.title: Add project delete flow
tasks.description: Close the project CRUD gap by adding project deletion with confirmation and list/detail invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: Project detail exposes a delete action gated behind an explicit confirmation that names the targeted project.
Successful deletion invalidates tracker index and project-detail queries, then returns the user to the project list without stale project rows.
Attempting to delete an archived, missing, or already-removed project shows a recoverable error state instead of leaving the user on a broken route.

tasks.title: Add sub-issue tree and create flow
tasks.description: Close the remaining sub-issue parity gap by rendering a real sub-issue tree and letting users create sub-issues from a parent issue context.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue detail renders a nested sub-issue tree with status, identifier, and title instead of only a count summary.
Creating a sub-issue from a parent issue pre-fills the parent relation and returns to the parent detail with the new child visible after save.
Missing or deleted child issues render a safe fallback row and do not break parent issue rendering.

tasks.title: Add attachment delete parity
tasks.description: Finish the tracker attachment workflow by allowing users to remove issue attachments and see the detail view update immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue detail renders a delete/remove action for attachments the current user is allowed to remove.
Successful attachment removal updates the visible attachment list without requiring a full issue reload.
Failed or unauthorized deletes leave the attachment visible and show a recoverable error instead of silently desynchronizing the UI.

tasks.title: Add rich comment composer parity
tasks.description: Close the remaining comment-composer gap by upgrading tracker comments from plain text to the same rich composition baseline used for issue descriptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Comment creation and editing use a richtext composer with formatting controls instead of a plain text field.
Existing markdown/rich comment content renders consistently after edit round-trips without dropping formatting.
When richtext capabilities are unavailable, the composer shows an explicit degraded state instead of silently falling back to malformed plain text submission.

failureModes.detection: Form has no valid status or default assignee context
failureModes.recovery: Block submit and show explicit metadata-loading state

failureModes.failure: Deleted milestone/component referenced by an issue
failureModes.detection: Detail screen receives missing related doc
failureModes.recovery: Render safe fallback row and offer reassignment
Stop hydration and show template repair message

failureModes.failure: Time-report mutation succeeds but detail stays stale
failureModes.detection: Reported time does not update after save
failureModes.recovery: Invalidate issue detail and project issue list query keys together

failureModes.detection: Issue form opens with wrong project metadata
failureModes.recovery: Clear persisted tracker draft when workspace identity changes

failureModes.detection: Some issues in a batch fail to update
failureModes.recovery: Show per-issue error count and offer retry for failed items

failureModes.failure: Project delete leaves stale project routes
failureModes.detection: Deleted project is still reachable from back stack
failureModes.recovery: Invalidate tracker list/detail keys and redirect to project index after successful delete

failureModes.detection: Removed file still appears until manual refresh
failureModes.recovery: Optimistically remove only after id match and invalidate issue detail on settle

failureModes.detection: Race between optimistic remove and server response
failureModes.recovery: Confirm by id match before cache eviction

failureModes.detection: Card dropped on wrong column updates wrong field
failureModes.recovery: Validate target column field before mutation

delivers: full issue create/edit/detail parity for core fields
safeToDefer: advanced filter UI beyond the current list/search core
